description: This file contains the JmsSerializer class which provides methods for serializing and deserializing objects to and from XML within the Apache OFBiz framework, specifically related to JMS messaging.

classes.name: JmsSerializer
classes.description: A facade class used to connect JMS code to the legacy XML serialization code within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Converts an XML string content into an object using XML deserialization, returning null and logging a warning if the document is null.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Converts an object into its XML string representation, creating an XML document with a root element 'ofbiz-ser'.
